newsitem.title: USA: Coke sees Q3 EPS "slightly higher" with gains.
newsitem.headline: Coke sees Q3 EPS "slightly higher" with gains.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said on Friday that with an expected gain from the sale of its stakes in two bottlers to Coca-Cola Enterprises, its third-quarter earnings per share will be "slightly higher" than for the same period a year ago.

Coca-Cola said in a news release that it expected a third-quarter gain of $0.04 to $0.06 per share from the sales, but provided no estimate of its earnings. First Call's consensus analysts' estimate for the third quarter was $0.44 per share. For the third quarter a year ago the company earned $0.39 per share.
